WHAT_THIS_GOVERNS: The 127-document recall run reports a 10.6% material miss rate on the audited 100. That number is publishable only in proportion to this sensitivity: at s, the corrected rate is roughly 10.6/s, and if s is low the honest report is the sensitivity alone. Quote the two together or neither.
LIMITS: A second model refereeing a first, both from the same family. The referee's task is far easier than the one it judges -- one name against a short list, no source text, no enumeration -- which is the only reason it is allowed to referee at all. Still not a human.
